description: This Dart source file defines various UI components and theming constants for a Flutter application, including application-wide theme data, a scaffold wrapper with gradient background, and an empty state widget.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: Provides app-wide ThemeData and color constants for maintaining a consistent style throughout the UI.

classes.name: OceanScaffold
classes.description: A reusable scaffold widget that applies a themed gradient background, standard AppBar, and optional actions and FAB.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget that displays a card with icon, title, subtitle, and optional action for empty or no-data sections.

methods.name: themeData
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with Ocean theme colors and styles.

methods.name: softGradientBackground
methods.description: Provides a BoxDecoration with a linear gradient background used in OceanScaffold.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for OceanScaffold and EmptyState widgets.
